description: A versioned collection of U1 validation-evidence records. registry_id is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of {schema, records}; the loader verifies it, then re-validates every record (structure, signature, licence/contamination presence). Records are typed as generic objects here because a relative $ref to evidence-record.schema.json does not resolve offline under Draft202012Validator (verified: Unresolvable); the Python loader in validation.py enforces the record shape against the evidence-record schema.

records.description: Evidence records, ordered by record_id. Each entry must validate against the evidence-record schema (enforced by the Python loader).

registry_id.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of {schema, records}.

title: TextForensics validation registry (U1)
